home.lead: The page combines gesture effects, dance detection, and Eevee recognition. Every interaction runs in real time from the camera feed and prefers the rear camera when available.

gesture.title: Fist-triggered gem effect
gesture.description: Hold a fist for 2 seconds, then open the palm to spawn a gem that follows the hand.

dance.title: Dance motion detection
dance.description: When the person keeps moving with enough energy, dancing bears appear around them.

eevee.title: Eevee recognition with 3D preview
eevee.description: Point a similar object to `eevee.png` at the camera to reveal an auto-rotating Eevee model and a short Pokédex summary.

smile.title: Smile-triggered devil mask
smile.description: When Face Mesh detects a smile, a devil mask appears and follows your face.

step1.title: 1. Keep one hand in frame
step1.description: Place one hand clearly inside the camera view so the landmarks remain stable.

step2.title: 2. Charge with a fist
step2.description: Hold a fist for about 2 seconds until the progress bar fills up.

step3.title: 3. Open to trigger
step3.description: Open the hand to trigger the gem effect, then make a fist again to reset it.

step1.title: 1. Stay fully visible
step1.description: Try to keep the head, shoulders, hips, and feet inside the frame for steadier pose tracking.

step2.title: 2. Keep moving
step2.description: Continuous motion from the limbs and torso raises the dance score.

step3.title: 3. Bears join the dance
step3.description: Once dancing is detected, several dancing bears appear around the person.

step1.title: 1. Use the rear camera
step1.description: The experience prefers the rear camera, which works better for printed cards, figures, and posters.

step2.title: 2. Center a similar image
step2.description: Place something visually close to `eevee.png` in the middle of the frame while the system compares it.

step3.title: 3. Reveal the model
step3.description: When similarity passes the threshold, the page shows `eevee.glb` and a short Eevee profile.

step1.title: 1. Keep your face in frame
step1.description: Use the rear camera and keep your face near the center of the view.

step2.title: 2. Smile at the camera
step2.description: Smile and hold it briefly while Face Mesh analyzes your facial landmarks.

step3.title: 3. Wear the devil mask
step3.description: The mask follows your face position and angle as you move.

instructions.hold: Hold a fist for about 2 seconds to charge the effect.
instructions.reset: After the gem appears, make a fist again to clear it and start over.
